## Reproduction

Record exact install/build commands and browser steps needed to repeat the measurement. Note cache state, warm/cold load, throttling, and number of samples.

## Interpretation

Explain what the result establishes and what it does not. Distinguish local build measurements from measurements of a deployed site. Include variance and unexpected results.

## Action

- Proposed optimization:

- Accessibility or maintainability trade-off:
- Owner:

- Acceptance threshold:

Do not present a single noisy measurement as a proven improvement.
